ranges.rule: StoreBuffer::fetch_store searches newest-to-oldest, stops at the CoWR/CoRR and SC-clock bounds, disallows stores marked sc_loaded for later SC reads, and retains only the newest SC-marked store while preserving unmarked candidates. It chooses among the resulting permitted candidates with the Miri RNG.
StoreElement::load_impl records the earliest per-thread load timestamp and whether any SC load observed this store.
buffered_atomic_read applies global.sc_read before selecting a value for an SC load, calls the store-buffer choice path, and records outdated-load diagnostics only when configured.
buffered_atomic_write calls global.sc_write for an SC store and marks the buffered write as SeqCst.
sc_write updates the per-thread last-SC-write clock; sc_read joins the last-SC-fence clock into the active thread's SC-read clock.
sched_yield only calls yield_active_thread and returns; it adds no synchronization clock or atomic memory operation.
The libc sched_yield shim checks the zero-argument i32 signature, invokes sched_yield, then writes the return value.
